name: devtools
description: The developer-machine toolchain in one plugin — mise (the .config/ three-file MISE_ENV split, tool/env placement, the file-based task library, the CI node-gpg workaround) plus /devtools:scaffold and the repo-level quality gates: dprint, ESLint, gitleaks, grype, pre-commit. Its stack adapter retired in Wave C, its Docker/OCI doctrine in Wave D and its Doppler doctrine with the secrets-manager packs — the deploy artifact is now stackgen's container-image pack, the local stack its harness contract, and secrets a user-picked provider on the backing axis. This plugin holds no secrets doctrine at all.
